title: Kissed Fluffy Brazilian Mango Bake
description: Jammy, fluffy, energizing dessert featuring mango puree and a subtle Grana Padano crust, baked to golden perfection in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line an earthenware bowl with parchment.
Blend the mangoes into a smooth sauce and set aside.
Whisk almond flour, coconut sugar, flaxseed, baking powder, and sea salt until combined.
Add the mango puree, coconut milk, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and mix until a uniform batter forms.
Pour the batter into the prepared earthenware bowl and smooth the top with a spatula.
Sprinkle grated Grana Padano evenly over the surface of the batter.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let the bake cool in the bowl for 5 minutes before transferring to a plate.
Garnish with toasted coconut flakes and serve warm as a comforting dessert.
